panels.description: Summary of Xray balancer egress operational health. UP: active route confirmed alive by Observatory probes. BLIND: active route is unmonitored (e.g. direct). DOWN: active route probe failed or no route available. See the balancers section below for details.

panels.title: Connection stats

targets.expr:
8 * (
  sum by (outbound) (rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
  and on (outbound)
  topk(6, sum by (outbound) (increase(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)
)

8 * (
  (
    sum(rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
    -
    sum(
      sum by (outbound) (rate(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
      and on (outbound)
      topk(6, sum by (outbound) (increase(xui_outbound_traffic_bytes_total{instance="${instance}",outbound!~"direct|blocked|_bl_.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)
    )
  ) > 0
)

panels.description: Operational status (UP/DOWN) of monitored outbounds and time elapsed since the last status change.
panels.title: Status

panels.description: Operational egress health for each balancer: UP (confirmed alive by Observatory probes), BLIND (unmonitored or direct route), DOWN (route probe failed or structurally unavailable).
panels.title: Egress health and routing state

panels.description: Combined outbound health and balancer selection state: UP (active & healthy), DEGRADED (active with probe loss), BLIND (active unmonitored route), DOWN (active route failed or blackhole), FAILED (standby candidate failing probes), Inactive (healthy standby candidate).

targets.expr:
# 1. Selected and healthy (UP = 2, DEGRADED = 1)
(
  (xui_balancer_outbound_selected{instance="${instance}", balancer=~"${balancer}", role="primary"} == 1)
  * on (instance, outbound) group_left()
  (
    ((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{instance="${instance}"} == 1) * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{instance="${instance}"} == bool 0)))
    or
    ((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{instance="${instance}"} == 1) * 2)
  )
)
or
# 2. Selected but down (DOWN = 0)
(
  (xui_balancer_outbound_selected{instance="${instance}", balancer=~"${balancer}", role="primary"} == 1) * 0
  + on (instance, outbound) group_left()
  (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{instance="${instance}"} == 0)
)
or
# 3. In reserve and down (FAILED = 4)
(
  (xui_balancer_outbound_selected{instance="${instance}", balancer=~"${balancer}", role="primary"} == 0) * 0 + 4
  + on (instance, outbound) group_left()
  (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{instance="${instance}"} == 0)
)
or
# 4. In reserve and healthy (Inactive = 21)
(
  xui_balancer_outbound_selected{instance="${instance}", balancer=~"${balancer}", role="primary"} * 0 + 21
)

panels.title: Outbound health & selection

panels.description: Percentage of time each target was selected by the balancer. Does not represent traffic volume share.
panels.title: Outbound selected time

panels.description: Number of observed 0/1 transitions across primary, fallback and override series in each minute. One target replacement can cause multiple transitions. Missing data and minute boundaries limit completeness; this is not a connection log. The window is centered on each minute; the latest bucket is incomplete.
panels.title: Selection state changes

panels.description: Consolidated runtime health, network latency, jitter, probe reliability, and overall quality score for outbounds in the selected balancer.
panels.title: Outbound quality & health

panels.description: Burst: mean RTT of successful samples in the observation window. Ordinary observatory: last successful delay. Seconds; no fabricated values on failure.
panels.title: Outbound latency

panels.description: Failed fraction in the current burst window, not a cumulative counter. Empty measurements remain absent.
panels.title: Burst failed probes

panels.description: Go runtime memory values; neither is process RSS.
panels.title: Go runtime memory

panels.description: GC pause seconds per elapsed second, displayed as a percentage.
panels.title: GC pause time

panels.description: Remote cluster node availability history over time. Green indicates online based on master panel heartbeat probes; red indicates offline. Missing data indicates collection failure or unconfigured nodes.
panels.title: Availability history

panels.description: Round-trip time (RTT) between master panel and remote cluster nodes. Based on master panel heartbeat probes. Missing data indicates offline nodes or heartbeat probe timeout.
panels.title: Latency

panels.description: Inventory of remote cluster nodes: Xray core process state, system uptime, configured inbounds, and software versions.
panels.title: Inventory

panels.description: Remote cluster node CPU and memory utilization percent over time. Missing data indicates offline nodes.
panels.title: Resources

panels.description: Aggregated inbound network throughput per remote cluster node. Based on inbound traffic counters reported by the master panel database. Step intervals reflect remote node heartbeat synchronization cadence.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Total inbound traffic volume transferred per remote cluster node over the selected time range. Sourced from the master panel database.
panels.title: Traffic volume

panels.description: Settings and server/status requests start in parallel. gRPC and expvars start after settings completes, without waiting for server/status. Source durations overlap and are shown without stacking. API is the elapsed span until both API requests finish, not their sum. Runtime is max(gRPC, expvars). Total is the end-to-end duration measured by Prometheus; source durations cannot be added to reconstruct it.
panels.title: Collection duration

panels.description: Resident Set Size (RSS) memory from OS process stats and live Go heap allocations.
panels.title: Exporter process memory

panels.description: Process CPU utilization rate and active Go runtime goroutines.
panels.title: Exporter CPU & Goroutines
